Neon Velocity

Race rivals through a neon city at night.

Neon Velocity is a 3D game for desktop and laptop browsers. You need a keyboard and mouse. The first load downloads a few megabytes.

Neon Velocity: Night Run

Steer with A and D, accelerate with W, drift with Space and use nitro with Shift.

Play Neon Velocity now

About Neon Velocity

Neon Velocity is a free 3D arcade racer for your browser. Pick a car, race three rivals over three laps, drift corners and burn your nitro. It is built with Three.js, React and a physics engine, and everything you see is generated in your browser.

How to play

WASD
Drive
Space
Drift
Shift
Nitro boost
C
Change camera
Esc
Pause

Neon Velocity needs a keyboard, so it is built for desktop and laptop browsers.

Tips

  • Stay on the glowing road. Driving on the grass slows you right down.
  • Hold Space while turning to drift. Drift score builds the longer you slide at speed.
  • Save nitro for the straight after a corner, and avoid bumping rivals because it costs you speed.

Frequently asked questions

How do you play Neon Velocity?

Press W to accelerate, steer with A and D, hold Space to drift and Shift for a nitro boost. Beat three rivals over the laps to finish first.

Can I play Neon Velocity on my phone?

No. It needs a keyboard, so it works best on a desktop or laptop in a current browser.
